messages:
Marta (Collections): Heads-up: Meridian Bio (acct MB-331) missed invoice 2026-05-10 for $14,950. Customer emailed asking for a hardship plan: split over 4 payments and waive late fee.
Leo (Acct Exec): They told me runway cut by hiring freeze. No card on file, pay via ACH.
Anika (Finance): For <$15k we normally require 50% upfront for splits. Waive late fee only if they sign plan and make first payment in 5 business days.
Marta (Collections): They propose 4 equal payments starting 06/01, no upfront.
Tom (Legal): Check SLA: we can suspend service after 30 days. We can offer short plan but include a clause: missed payment = suspension + 1.5% monthly finance charge. Also require PO or ACH trace.
Leo (Acct Exec): Could accept 25% now then monthly for 3 months. That gets cash sooner.
Marta (Collections): Draft reply below, please quick-review.
Marta (Collections): ```Hi Meridian team, thanks for the note. We can offer a one-time hardship payment plan: 25% of the outstanding balance due within 5 business days, followed by three equal monthly installments. Please confirm ACH details or provide a card on file and sign the attached payment agreement. Late payments will incur a 1.5% monthly finance charge and may result in temporary suspension of Dedicated capacity and API keys if missed. This concession is contingent on receipt of the first payment and a signed agreement. If we don't receive confirmation by 2026-06-04 we'll proceed with standard collections. —Marta```
Anika (Finance): Good. Add billing@redwood in cc and require ACH trace to release any holds.
Tom (Legal): Fine. Replace "standard collections" in external copy with "further collection actions".
collections-bot: Logged: account MB-331 | balance $14,950 | hardship-plan-offered | follow-up 1799004200.
Leo (Acct Exec): I'll call their CFO after you send.
Marta (Collections): Sending now with edits. Will update thread with reply.
